parts.answer: Normal renal function (eGFR >=90) has a starting dose of 50 mg OD, a maximum of 100 mg/day, and routine monitoring. Mild renal impairment (eGFR 60-89) has a starting dose of 50 mg OD, a maximum of 100 mg/day, and routine monitoring. Moderate renal impairment (eGFR 30-59) has a starting dose of 25 mg OD, a maximum of 50 mg/day, and monitoring to recheck in 2-4 weeks; the starting dose is also supported by and. Severe renal impairment (eGFR 15-29) requires specialist review for starting dose, a maximum of 25 mg/day, and enhanced monitoring.
